name: Murloc Poachers
label: Quest
description: Dockmaster Baren of Lakeshire needs adventurers to thin the swelling ranks of murlocs along Lake Everstill before they deplete the town's primary food…
intro: Dockmaster Baren of Lakeshire needs adventurers to thin the swelling ranks of murlocs along Lake Everstill before they deplete the town's primary food source. What begins as a practical pest-control bounty raises an unsettling ecological question: why are coastal creatures settling so deep into the inland mountains?

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Murlocs are becoming a problem. Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm! We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!
Hunt murlocs! Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have those fins? Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.
It's strange seeing them so far from the sea. I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
